weapons.name: Night's Edge
weapons.source: Crafted (Blade of Grass, Muramasa, Volcano, Light's Bane/Blood Butcherer)
weapons.why: Combines the best pre-Hardmode swords into a wide-arc broadsword.

weapons.name: Cascade
weapons.source: 1/400 drop from Underworld enemies after Skeletron is defeated (pre-Hardmode only)
weapons.why: Post-Skeletron Underworld drop that can inflict On Fire!.

weapons.name: Combat Wrench
weapons.source: Dropped by the Mechanic NPC (1/8), obtainable after Skeletron
weapons.why: Piercing boomerang dropped by the Mechanic, available after Skeletron.

weapons.name: Blue Moon
weapons.source: Found in Locked Gold Chests (Dungeon) and Golden Lock Boxes
weapons.why: Dungeon flail requiring Skeletron to access the Locked Gold Chests.

weapons.name: Sunfury
weapons.source: Found in Shadow Chests (Underworld) and Obsidian Lock Boxes
weapons.why: Underworld Shadow Chest flail from the Hellstone tier.

weapons.name: Dark Lance
weapons.source: Found in Underworld Shadow Chests (Shadow Key) and Obsidian Lock Boxes
weapons.why: Underworld Shadow Chest spear opened with a Dungeon-found Shadow Key.

weapons.name: Muramasa
weapons.source: Found in Dungeon Locked Gold Chests
weapons.why: Fast broadsword found in the Dungeon after Skeletron.

weapons.name: Obsidian Swordfish
weapons.source: Fished in lava (lava fishing in the Underworld)
weapons.why: Lava-fished spear that also fires piercing embers on thrust.

weapons.name: Valor
weapons.source: Found in the Dungeon's Gold Chests (requires Skeletron for access)
weapons.why: Dungeon Gold Chest yoyo requiring Skeletron for access.

weapons.name: Hive-Five
weapons.source: Crafted (14 Bee Wax at an Iron/Lead Anvil); Bee Wax drops from Queen Bee
weapons.why: Crafted from Queen Bee's Bee Wax and releases homing bee projectiles.

weapons.name: Flamarang
weapons.source: Crafted at an Anvil from Enchanted Boomerang and 15 Hellstone Bars
weapons.why: Hellstone-tier boomerang that inflicts On Fire.

weapons.name: Phaseblades
weapons.source: Crafted (15 Meteorite Bars + 15 gems, at an Anvil)
weapons.why: Group of nine identical broadswords; can be thrown while swinging.

weapons.name: Starfury
weapons.source: Found in Skyware Chests (Floating Islands)
weapons.why: Calls a falling star from the sky on each swing.

weapons.name: Volcano
weapons.source: Crafted (Hellstone Bars)
weapons.why: Crafted from Hellstone Bars; creates an explosion on hitting enemies.

weapons.name: Ball O' Hurt
weapons.source: Dropped by Shadow Orbs (Corruption); found in Corrupt/Defiled Crates
weapons.why: Corruption flail obtained by breaking Shadow Orbs, needs no boss.

armor.name: Molten Armor
armor.why: 10% extra melee damage, immunity to fire blocks, and you cannot be set on fire.

accessories.name: Obsidian Shield
accessories.why: Knockback immunity, fire block immunity and 2 defense. Combines Cobalt Shield and Obsidian Skull.

accessories.name: Lava Waders
accessories.source: Crafted (Obsidian Water Walking Boots + Lava Charm)
accessories.why: If you can assemble them, they make Wall of Flesh arena setup and Hellstone cleanup dramatically safer.

accessories.name: Spectre Boots
accessories.why: Combines sprinting boots with Rocket Boots, so you can run fast and fly briefly.

accessories.name: Shield of Cthulhu
accessories.source: Dropped from the Eye of Cthulhu treasure bag
accessories.why: Expert Mode only. Gives a dash that also damages enemies and grants brief invulnerability.

accessories.name: Magma Stone
accessories.source: Dropped by Hellbats and Lava Bats
accessories.why: Adds fire damage to melee strikes.

buffs.name: Ironskin Potion
buffs.why: This remains the safest default combat potion for late pre-Hardmode melee.

buffs.name: Regeneration Potion
buffs.why: It makes long boss bridges and Underworld fights more forgiving.

buffs.name: Swiftness Potion
buffs.why: Extra movement speed is still one of the best ways to improve real fight consistency.

buffs.name: Endurance Potion
buffs.why: Damage reduction gets better the scarier the fight becomes, and this phase has the scariest pre-Hardmode one.

buffs.name: Sharpening Station
buffs.why: The armor penetration bonus is one of the best class-specific pre-Hardmode melee boosts.

buffs.name: Ale
buffs.why: Tipsy: more melee damage and crit for less defense.

buffs.name: Flask of Poison
buffs.source: Brewed at an Imbuing Station (Bottled Water + Stinger)
buffs.why: Coats melee hits with the Poisoned debuff.

items.name: Amphibian Boots
items.why: Combines the effects of sprinting boots with the Frog Leg.

items.name: Lightning Boots
items.why: Combines the effects of sprinting boots with Rocket Boots, but allows the player to accelerate faster and reach a higher max speed than Spectre Boots.

items.name: Fledgling Wings
items.why: Allows the player to fly briefly and glide (and negates fall damage).

items.name: Bundle of Horseshoe Balloons
items.why: Provides substantial vertical mobility and acceleration.

items.name: Ram Rune
items.why: Allows the player to perform a ground-pound, which greatly increases the player's downward mobility and damages nearby enemies.
items.notes: The Ram Rune can be relevant into Hardmode in some niche scenarios if combined with a Gravitation Potion, as it provides high vertical acceleration on par with the Slimy Saddle, but can be used both upwards and downwards.

items.name: Balloons
items.why: Combines the effects of an extra jump with balloons and a Lucky Horseshoe.

items.name: Magiluminescence
items.why: Increases the player's movement speed by 15%, and their acceleration (and deceleration) by 75%. This movement speed buff no longer applies if the player is not grounded.

items.name: Panic Necklace
items.why: Briefly increases the player's movement speed after they take damage. Can be upgraded into the Stinger Necklace.

items.name: Worm Scarf
items.why: Reduces all damage taken by 17%.

items.name: Band of Regeneration
items.why: Increases the player's passive health regeneration by 1 HP/s (which ignores the effects of the Bleeding debuff).

items.name: Honey Comb
items.why: When the player is hit:

items.name: Shark Tooth Necklace
items.why: Provides all weapons with 5 unconditional armor penetration. Can be stacked with or upgraded into the Stinger Necklace.
items.notes: The player should use the Shark Tooth Necklace (or its upgrade) if they are unable to consistently damage the Wall of Flesh's eyes, as its mouth has considerably higher defense.

items.name: Hive Pack
items.why: Increases the damage of friendly bees.

items.name: Bone Helm
items.why: Summons Shadow Hand projectiles to damage enemies.

items.name: Bone Glove
items.why: Causes crossbone projectiles to be thrown from the player's weapon at a maximum of once every second.

items.name: Strung Counterweight
items.why: Combines the effects of Yoyo Strings and Counterweights.

items.name: Feral Claws
items.why: Increases melee speed by 12%.

weapons.name: Hellwing Bow
weapons.source: Found in Shadow Chests and Obsidian Lock Boxes (Underworld)
weapons.why: Turns arrows into bats that bounce off surfaces.

weapons.name: Phoenix Blaster
weapons.source: Crafted (Handgun + 10 Hellstone Bars)
weapons.why: Upgrade to the Handgun crafted from Hellstone Bars in the Underworld.

weapons.name: Quad-Barrel Shotgun
weapons.source: Purchased from the Arms Dealer in a Graveyard after Skeletron is defeated (35 GC)
weapons.why: Sold by the Arms Dealer in a Graveyard only after Skeletron is defeated.

weapons.name: Handgun
weapons.source: Found in Locked Gold Chests and Golden Lock Boxes in the Dungeon
weapons.why: Pre-Hardmode gun found in the Dungeon, which requires defeating Skeletron.

weapons.name: Molten Fury
weapons.source: Crafted from Hellstone Bars
weapons.why: Hellstone-tier bow that ignites the arrows it fires.

weapons.name: Star Cannon
weapons.source: Crafted (Minishark + 20 Meteorite Bars + 5 Fallen Stars)
weapons.why: Fires Fallen Stars for high damage, limited by how many stars you have collected.

weapons.name: The Bee's Knees
weapons.source: Dropped by Queen Bee
weapons.why: Converts wooden arrows into homing bees.

accessories.name: Obsidian Shield
accessories.why: Knockback immunity, fire block immunity and 2 defense. Combines Cobalt Shield and Obsidian Skull.

accessories.name: Spectre Boots
accessories.why: Combines sprinting boots with Rocket Boots, so you can run fast and fly briefly.

accessories.name: Lava Waders
accessories.source: Crafted (Obsidian Water Walking Boots + Lava Charm)
accessories.why: If you can assemble them, they make Wall of Flesh arena setup and Hellstone cleanup dramatically safer.

accessories.name: Shield of Cthulhu
accessories.source: Dropped from the Eye of Cthulhu treasure bag
accessories.why: Expert Mode only. Gives a dash that also damages enemies and grants brief invulnerability.

accessories.name: Band of Regeneration
accessories.why: The passive healing is small on paper but adds up fast when paired with campfires and heart lanterns.

buffs.name: Archery Potion
buffs.why: Raises arrow damage by 10% and arrow speed by 20%. Bows only.

buffs.name: Ammo Reservation Potion
buffs.why: This keeps your best arrows and bullets alive longer in a phase where boss attempts can chew through supplies.

buffs.name: Ironskin Potion
buffs.why: Defense remains useful because even ranged mistakes get punished hard in the Underworld.

ammo.name: Jester's Arrow
ammo.source: Crafted by hand from Wooden Arrows and Fallen Stars
ammo.why: Passes through blocks and enemies, hitting everything in a line. Useful against the Eater of Worlds and the Wall of Flesh.

ammo.name: Unholy Arrow
ammo.source: Crafted at an Anvil from Wooden Arrows and Worm Teeth
ammo.why: Pierces several enemies. Worm Teeth come from the Eater of Worlds.

ammo.name: Meteor Shot
ammo.source: Crafted at an Anvil from Musket Balls and Meteorite Bars

weapons.name: Water Bolt
weapons.source: Found on Dungeon bookshelves (requires Skeletron for Dungeon access)
weapons.why: Fires a slow, piercing water ball that bounces off walls.

weapons.name: Flamelash
weapons.source: Found in Shadow Chests / Obsidian Lock Boxes (Underworld)
weapons.why: Fires a cursor-controlled fireball found in Underworld Shadow Chests.

weapons.name: Flower of Fire
weapons.source: Found in Shadow Chests / Obsidian Lock Boxes (Underworld)
weapons.why: Throws a bouncing fireball that explodes on contact.

weapons.name: Book of Skulls
weapons.source: Dropped by Skeletron
weapons.why: Fires slow homing skull projectiles that pierce twice.

weapons.name: Magic Missile
weapons.source: Found in Locked Gold Chests / Golden Lock Boxes in the Dungeon (requires Skeletron)
weapons.why: Fires a player-guided missile controlled by the cursor.

weapons.name: Gray Zapinator
weapons.source: Purchased from the Traveling Merchant (pre-Hardmode)
weapons.why: Fires an erratic light beam that ricochets and varies in size.

weapons.name: Weather Pain
weapons.source: Dropped by Deerclops
weapons.why: Fires a slow weather-front projectile that spawns damaging effects.

weapons.name: Demon Scythe
weapons.source: Dropped by Demons and Voodoo Demons in the Underworld
weapons.why: Fires accelerating sickle projectiles that pierce up to five enemies.

weapons.name: Aqua Scepter
weapons.source: Found in Gold Chests / Golden Lock Boxes
weapons.why: Sprays a stream of water droplets that pierce enemies.

weapons.name: Crimson Rod
weapons.source: Destroyed from Crimson Hearts (1/5), or fished in Crimson/Hematic Crates
weapons.why: Places a lingering blood cloud that rains piercing droplets downward onto enemies below.

weapons.name: Thunder Zapper
weapons.source: Found in Sandstone Chests and Oasis/Mirage Crates (Desert)
weapons.why: Fires an electric bolt that pierces one enemy, found in the Desert.

armor.name: Meteor Armor
armor.why: Space Gun costs 0 mana, so it pairs with that weapon specifically.

armor.name: Jungle Armor
armor.source: Crafted from Jungle Spores, Stingers and Vines
armor.why: 16% reduced mana costs. Not tied to one weapon the way Meteor armor is.

armor.name: Wizard set
armor.source: Wizard Hat from Tim, or Magic Hat from the Traveling Merchant, plus any gem robe
armor.why: 60 extra maximum mana and 10% magic critical strike chance. Any leg armor keeps the bonus, so it stacks with Jungle or Meteor leggings.

accessories.name: Mana Flower
accessories.why: Auto-using mana potions makes mage much easier to pilot and keeps your attention on dodging.

accessories.name: Celestial Cuffs
accessories.why: Combines Celestial Magnet and Magic Cuffs, so one slot covers both star pickup range and mana on hit.

accessories.name: Obsidian Shield
accessories.why: Knockback immunity, fire block immunity and 2 defense. Combines Cobalt Shield and Obsidian Skull.

buffs.name: Mana Regeneration Potion
buffs.why: Speeds up mana regeneration, so you stop to drink fewer mana potions.

buffs.name: Ironskin Potion
buffs.why: The defense boost still buys much-needed breathing room for a fragile class.

buffs.name: Crystal Ball
buffs.why: The Clairvoyance station buff is an easy mage-specific bonus if you have the setup time.

weapons.name: Spinal Tap
weapons.source: Crafted (90 Bone + 55 Cobweb at a Work Bench)
weapons.why: Crafted from Bones and offers long range with piercing.

weapons.name: Snapthorn
weapons.source: Crafted (15 Stinger + 3 Vine + 12 Jungle Spores at an Anvil)
weapons.why: Jungle-material whip that inflicts Acid Venom and grants summon tag damage.

weapons.name: Imp Staff
weapons.source: Crafted from 17 Hellstone Bars at an Iron/Lead Anvil
weapons.why: Summons an Imp minion that fires On Fire! bolts; needs Underworld Hellstone.

weapons.name: Ballista Rod
weapons.source: Bought from the Tavernkeep for Defender Medals (tier 1)
weapons.why: Tier 1 Tavernkeep sentry that fires high-damage piercing bolts.

weapons.name: Explosive Trap Rod
weapons.source: Bought from the Tavernkeep for Defender Medals (tier 1)
weapons.why: Tier 1 Tavernkeep sentry that lays a trap detonating when enemies pass over it.

weapons.name: Mushroom Staff
weapons.source: Crafted from 300 Glowing Mushrooms + 5 Mushroom Grass Seeds + 5 Shadow Scales/Tissue Samples at an Iron/Lead Anvil
weapons.why: Summons a Mushroom Boi minion; requires an evil-boss drop (Shadow Scale or Tissue Sample) to craft.

weapons.name: Flinx Staff
weapons.source: Crafted from 6 Flinx Fur + 10 Gold/Platinum Bars at a Work Bench
weapons.why: Summons a Flinx minion; Flinx Fur drops from Snow Flinxes in the Snow biome.

weapons.name: Vampire Frog Staff
weapons.source: Dropped by Zombie Merman and Wandering Eye Fish (Blood Moon)
weapons.why: Summons a Vampire Frog minion; obtainable during a Blood Moon with no boss required.

weapons.name: Houndius Shootius
weapons.source: Dropped by Deerclops
weapons.why: Pre-Hardmode sentry dropped by Deerclops that shoots piercing fireballs.

weapons.name: Starcrash
weapons.source: Crafted (20 Meteorite Bar + 10 Chain + 10 Fallen Star at an Anvil)
weapons.why: Summons falling star projectiles on hit that deal extra damage.

armor.name: Obsidian Armor
armor.source: Crafted from Obsidian, evil-biome materials, and Silk
armor.why: Whip range +30%, whip speed +15%, summon damage +15%.

armor.name: Bee Armor
armor.why: Summon damage +10%. Less defense than Obsidian, and no whip bonus.

buffs.name: Bewitching Table
buffs.why: It is another easy minion-slot increase and should be part of any serious boss prep routine.

buffs.name: Well Fed
buffs.why: Summoner still wants every easy stat edge it can get, and this one is almost free.

buffs.name: Ironskin Potion
buffs.why: The defense gain helps offset the class's usual fragility during longer boss attempts.
